tokens.note: Monochrome system from the 2023 Wolff Olins / Dinamo / Active Theory rebrand. primary = pure black (#000000) CTA fill on light surfaces, inverting to white (#ffffff) on dark surfaces. Single typeface (Oracle) at ultra-light weight 250 for expressive display. Marketing site is rem-scaled ≈1.5×; token sizes are design-intent (≈ live computed ÷ 1.5). Periwinkle/cornflower (#94bbff / #71a0ff) and brand blue (#002a57) are expressive accents, not chrome.
